note: One row per donut record carrying a measured profile. Grams are per piece as the source publishes them, and a piece is not a fixed weight — serving_g says what was weighed. Positions are 1-based ingredient order off the label; 0 means the label never lists it; null means nobody here could read a label.

donuts.name: Cake donut
donuts.note: USDA SR Legacy 174992, "Doughnuts, cake-type, plain, sugared or glazed", published per 100 g and scaled here to the portion USDA itself lists as "doughnut, medium (approx 3" dia)" — 45 g. USDA publishes no total-sugars figure for this food, so sugar is null rather than estimated. No ingredient list is published for these generic rows, so the ingredient ranks are null. A shop's own donut is not this donut; this is the closest published measurement of the kind.
